text:
```yaml
name: Generate LLM.txt Documentation
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/generate_llm_txt.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
  release:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-llm-txt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Generate llm.txt
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_llm_txt.py

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add llm.txt
          if git diff-index --quiet HEAD; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "docs: update llm.txt with latest CLI documentation" || echo "Nothing to commit"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
